title: remove reset-test rust-{openssl,curl}-sys
commit_message:
remove reset-test rust-{openssl,curl}-sys
    
Newer gcc-11 addresses the issue.
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index 0ce735c..3b4a9bc 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -514,9 +514,6 @@ force-reset-test rust-debcargo/2.4.4-1/s390x
 force-reset-test rust-debcargo/2.4.4-1/armhf
 ## allowed to regress in Debian/testing, don't hold up the transition here
 force-reset-test rust-glib/0.8.2-1
-## LP: #1941920 for rust-openssl-sys and all that build-depend on it
-force-reset-test rust-openssl-sys/0.9.55-2/armhf
-force-reset-test rust-curl-sys/0.4.36-1/armhf
 ## choices are failing autopkgtest or uninstallability/removal, and rust-ryu has reverse-dependencies
 force-reset-test rust-ryu/1.0.2-1
 ##
